what: Three or more cards in a horizontal row cycle their widths like breathing with flex 5·4·3 — the current slot is 5, the one before it is 4, the rest are 3, and while the row is visible on screen it shifts one slot every 3.6s, widening and narrowing in 1.2s cubic-bezier(.24,1,.34,1). Hovering a card makes that slot 5 and pauses the cycle, and leaving the row restarts it from that spot

options.--fx-dur: Duration of the width change (css variable), default 1.2s
options.--fx-ease: Curve for changing widths (css variable), default cubic-bezier(.24,1,.34,1)
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Card right below the row — needs three or more to rotate

note: Only the width changes, so photos inside cards either fix the cell height or fill it with object-fit. When stacking vertically like on a phone, the consumer turns flex off (below 1024px the original uses a different effect that enlarges items closer to the center)
